next.reason: 1985 format 5 (DIVIDE identifier-1 BY identifier-2 ... REMAINDER): the first operand divided by the second, then as format 4. The 2023 format 5 (§2023:14.9.12.2) writes identifier-2 BY identifier-1 and §2023:14.9.12.4 GR2 makes identifier-2 the dividend, so the written order means the same; §2023:14.9.12.4 GR1, GR6 and GR7 carry the format-4 process for both formats.
